name: jev-gate
description: One Claude Code plugin from the jev-gate repository: the Jev orchestration gate, an instant extractive compactor, a Vitest log folder, a Jev effort and model router and a read-only evidence search tool. Each part is off until you enable it.

plugins.name: jev-gate
plugins.description: The orchestration gate (a planner and tiered workers past a context-depth floor), extractive compaction, Vitest log folding, a Jev effort and model router and the jev_evidence tool, in one install. Each part is off until enabled. Built from the tagged release; needs Node 22, a TypeSafe key for the Jev parts, and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 for compaction, folding and routing.
